svg.title: Shizhong: I track what AI agents take apart
svg.desc: Curator of four fact-checked, bilingual lists: Awesome REA, on what AI agents reverse-engineered and rebuilt; Awesome Hacker News Data, on projects built from Hacker News data; Awesome TV Debloat, on taking ads out of smart TVs; and Awesome Switch Recomp, on Switch games recompiled to run natively.
